records.title: LLM DNA: Tracing Model Evolution via Functional Representations
records.reason: Full text extracts low-dimensional model fingerprints and builds evolutionary trees; it studies model identity/relationships, not routing efficiency or inference resources.

records.title: State-space modeling in long sequence processing: a survey on recurrence in the transformer era
records.reason: Full survey reviews recurrent/SSM and long-context Transformer optimization, complexity, and online processing; it is a research map rather than a new measured optimization, so retain as borderline.

records.title: Output Scaling: YingLong-Delayed Chain of Thought in a Large Pretrained Time Series Forecasting Model
records.reason: YingLong is a masked, bidirectional time-series forecasting model whose output scaling improves forecast accuracy. Its forecasting objective and non-causal masked-recovery architecture are distinct from autoregressive LLM serving, and the multi-token-prediction citation is not an inference contribution here.

records.title: A hybrid model based on transformer and Mamba for enhanced sequence modeling
records.reason: Full paper reports competitive inference speeds but provides no detailed complexity or training/inference-time comparison; retain as borderline until resource claims are quantified.

records.title: SILMM: Self-Improving Large Multimodal Models for Compositional Text-to-Image Generation
records.reason: SILMM uses iterative self-feedback and preference optimization to improve compositional text-to-image alignment. The target output is generated imagery and the method concerns alignment/training, not language-model decoding or reduced inference resource use; the LLaVA token-reduction citation is an adjacent multimodal lineage but not the contribution evaluated here.
